snippet.title: '99 Koushien (PS1) - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Game: '99 Koushien
Platform: Sony PlayStation
Release Year: 1999

This is a recording of the start of the Story mode in '99 Koshien, a high school baseball game by Magical Company. You play as the captain of your high school team in Japan, and get to experience the busiest, loudest menus in the history of gaming. 

***
You can also check out my website about baseball video games at https://30-30.club.
